verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms threejs.org serves llms.txt at the site root, linking to a docs llms.txt with an explicit 'Instructions for Large Language Models' section and a 363 KB llms-full.txt of the complete docs. The llms.txt content is clearly agent-oriented, with prescriptive guidance such as 'CORRECT - modern pattern' and 'Use Import Maps (Not Old CDN Patterns)'. missing for 10: per-page markdown or static doc URLs (the .md probe returns 404 and human pages are hash-routed, so the llms files are the only machine path).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
